high_level_description: The image depicts a group of marathon runners participating in a race set against a stunning mountainous backdrop. The runners are spread out along a dirt path that cuts through a rugged, arid landscape. The mountains in the background are majestic, with snow-capped peaks under a clear blue sky, suggesting a high-altitude location. The runners are dressed in athletic gear, with some wearing singlets and others in t-shirts, all adorned with race numbers pinned to their clothing. The numbers range from 203 to 1109, indicating a large number of participants.
